 The Kabul Tribune (KT)—Afghanistan will face Zimbabwe on 
Monday in the tri-nation cricket series also featuring Bangladesh. 
 The match is scheduled to begin at 4 p.m. Afghanistan time 
at Sheikh Zayed Stadium in the United Arab Emirates. 
 Zimbabwe opened the series with a convincing 99-run victory 
over Bangladesh in the first match of the tournament, hosted by Afghanistan.
